headline: Reduce subsidies and comply with fiscal rule, IMF recommends to DR
summary: The IMF cited the Dominican economy's solid performance, with GDP up 4.6% through September. It said short-term policy should focus on reducing subsidy costs and safeguarding fiscal sustainability.
why: The IMF is the International Monetary Fund, which assesses member economies and advises on fiscal and monetary policy. Its recommendations signal how government spending and debt risk may evolve for investors in the country.
original_headline: Reducir subsidios y cumplir regla fiscal, lo que recomienda FMI a RD
